headline: GMAT CelestialBody.Mu is SET-ONLY (docs CelestialBody.html Access: set); direct script read-back is impossible. mu verified via GMAT-installed data files + empirical point-mass circular-orbit read-back (mu = R*|v(0)|^2).

Mercury.source: GMAT read-back, task B (GMAT internal Mercury parameter); NOT present in GMAT install (no gravity .cof, no DE405 entry); CelestialBody.Mu set-only -> not script-readable

Venus.source: GMAT read-back, task B (reference: GMAT data\gravity\venus\MGNP180U.cof l.7 POTFIELD ... 3.24858592079000e+14 m3/s2)

Earth.source: GMAT data\gravity\earth\EGM96.cof l.7 3.98600441500000E+14 (== legacy; no change)

Luna.source: GMAT data\gravity\luna\LP165P.cof l.7 4.90280105600000e+12 m3/s2; legacy 4902.800066 KEPT per requirement

Mars.source: GMAT data\gravity\mars\Mars50c.cof l.7 GM=42828.370371; legacy 42828.375214 KEPT per requirement

Jupiter.source: GMAT read-back, task B (reference: DE405 readme jup230 l.373 System 1.267127648382719E+08 km3/s2)

Sun.source: GMAT read-back, task B (reference: DE405 readme sat132 l.460 GM10 1.327124400179870E+11 km3/s2; NOT the jup230 l.385 constant)
